time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0; time t -> frame round(t*fps)
units: pixels (full 3840x2160 resolution) and seconds; no metric scale assumed
description: Front-on, near-static handheld view of a sandstone two-storey arcade building (arched loggia on both floors) with a paved walkway and a green reflecting pond in front. Three brown dabbling ducks (Pacific-black-duck-like) are in the pond in the lower part of the frame: one sits still on a submerged rock (left), one swims steadily leftward (middle), one swims slowly leftward while dabbling/preening inside its own ripple rings (right).

camera.summary: Background (facade) shift vs frame 0: dx within -0.2..+0.9 px, dy from 0 to about -6 px by frame 51 (image content moves up). Patch matches at frame 51 give dy -2 px (left, walkway) to -10 px (right, pond edge) and dx -1..+3 px, i.e. a slight roll/tilt. Negligible horizontally relative to duck motion; ref_x_bgcorr / ref_y_bgcorr in the tracks subtract the global shift.

objects.name: duck_middle
objects.distinguish: middle of the three ducks, swimming on open water at y~1880, head to the LEFT, pale cheek with dark eye stripe visible, pale tail tip to the right
objects.motion: swims steadily left (-x) through the whole clip; ref_x 2338.8 -> 2164.8 (about -174 px, about -3.4 px/frame, slightly faster at the end); drifts down about +10 px in image (+16 px vs background)

pixel_size.note: length = mask bbox width (body axis is horizontal, axis_deg ~ -5..+1); early frames 0-9 under-segment the pale tail tip (116-121 px), frames 12-51 give 124-130 px

objects.name: duck_right
objects.distinguish: right-most duck at x~3180-3360, surrounded by concentric ripple rings, head down/blurred (dabbling or preening), tail up to the right
objects.motion: drifts/swims slowly left; ref_x 3295.0 -> 3181.9 (about -113 px, about -2.2 px/frame, noisy because body posture changes); ref_y 1898 -> 1918 partly from head going down (mask top drops from y~1870 to ~1895 at frame 27)

pixel_size.note: head is mostly underwater or a semi-transparent motion-blurred blob above the body (excluded from mask); length is body+tail
